sentences.text:
Author: Rajesh Kumar Bench: Rajesh Kumar  IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI  B.A. No.4861 of 2023  ----
Premlal Murmu .... .... Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) Versus 1. The State of Jharkhand 2. Gidamati Hasda .... .... Opposite Parties ----
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ----
For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Lukesh Kumar, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Rakesh Ranjan, A.P.P.
 ----
 10/Dated: 15th February, 2024 1.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant, who is in custody since 21.01.2023, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with S.T No.92 of 2023, arising out of Sunderpahari P.S. Case No.30 of 2022,
corresponding to G.R No.380 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Godda.

3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
4.
Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the applicant has surrendered before the Court below after rejection of the Anticipatory Bail.
Further, it has been submitted that except the bald statement, there is no other corroborating materials.
No external injury has been found.
Although, there is specific allegation of biting on the hand.

Further, it has been submitted that the Premlal Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89031773/
1 charge has already been framed on 15.04.2023, but till date not a single witness has been examined.

entities.text: Premlal Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the above facts and the statement of the victim girl, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Godda in connection with S.T No.92 of 2023, arising out of Sunderpahari P.S. Case No.30 of 2022, corresponding to G.R No.380 of 2023, subject to condition that the applicant(s) will submit self-attested photocopy/photocopies of his/her/their Aadhaar Card(s) and also submit his/her/their mobile number(s) before the learned court below which he/she/they will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Raja/-Uploaded Premlal Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89031773/
